data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: open the form, enter origin and destination with suggestion picks, set dates, trip type, travelers and cabin, click Find flights, then pick a fare. It also covers every true parameter and correctly includes book_with_miles. It loses points because it splits travelers into adults/children, lists trip_type before the cities instead of with the dates step, and leaves the depart-date step vague about selecting by fare/miles price, as in the 20.9k click.
